description: Rep. Gina Hinojosa The LBJ Presidential Library’s Future Forum hosted its biennial Future of Texas discussion on Thursday, Feb. 16, 2017. Four state legislators reviewed the issues facing the Texas Legislature’s current 85th session: Rep. Trent Ashby, R-Lufkin, Sen. Dawn Buckingham, R-Lakeway, Rep. Gina Hinojosa, D-Austin, and Rep. Gene Wu, D-Houston. Moderating the discussion was Ben Philpott, senior editor at KUT, Austin’s National Public Radio station. LBJ Library photo by Jay Godwin 02/16/2017
